purpose: classification criteria + per-label split, added to the seal BEFORE any run (owner rule 2026-11-11 #2)

criteria.measurable: label is on a URL reachable by an UNAUTHENTICATED crawl and matches an engine battery class, so an engine finding could in principle be matched to it
criteria.out_of_scope: label needs authenticated session flows, client-side (JS/Flash) rendering, multi-step attacker actions, mobile app, TLS layer, DoS class, or is not an HTTP-response-observable class
criteria.review_rule: owner reviews classification before step-zero scoring (spec v2.2 §8 step 1); reclassification = new seal commit with documented reason
